refinement.prompt: Edit this sprite sheet to fix production slicing. Preserve the exact 18 character designs and blue pen style, but REDISTRIBUTE them into a mathematically regular SIX column x THREE row grid. Each full character must fit wholly inside the inner 70 percent of its own equal cell with minimum 15 percent transparent clearance on all four sides. Do not crop, cut off feet, weapons, shield or horns. Do not draw borders or grid lines. ALL characters need the SAME maximum height within a row; do not let the ogres extend into another row. Keep the character column species order and row pose order. Remove stray motion/splash lines extending outside the character silhouette; the spitter attack ink should stop inside its own cell. Real alpha transparency, no paper background. No text or extra objects. The final sheet must have empty transparent space all around every one of the 18 complete isolated silhouettes.
